verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly show a `minimum_release_age` setting (e.g. "7d") to block newly-released package versions, plus `MISE_SAFE=1` to prevent project configuration from executing code (covering lifecycle-script-style risks), alongside built-in signature/provenance verification (Cosign/Minisign/SLSA/attestations). These are first-party documented, concrete platform-engineer-facing security controls matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of these specific settings in real-world use and explicit mention of blocking npm/pip 'lifecycle scripts' by name rather than general code execution.
